title: The EarLens Contact Hearing Device (CHD) Spectrum Study
brief_summary: The EarLens System is an assistive hearing device that is intended to provide amplification for the treatment of patients with sensorineural hearing impairment. The purpose of the proposed study (Extended Investigation under the Continued Access Policy) is to continue to allow access to the investigational medical device with the collection of device utility and clinic process-flow data while the marketing application is under review at the FDA.
